title: 36 Hours in Chicago
abstract: From the historic high-rises of the Gold Coast to regal Hyde Park, to the bohemian barrios of Logan Square and Pilsen, Chicago demands hard choices.

title: 36 Hours in Sydney
abstract: Hit golden beaches, soak up contemporary culture, explore atmospheric bars and, sure, catch a glimpse of that opera house during a weekend in Australia’s most populous city.

title: 36 Hours in Basel, Switzerland
abstract: From bars and boutiques to culture and cuisine, this small city near France and Germany offers plenty to pack into a weekend.

title: 36 Hours in Manchester, Vt.
abstract: From sleigh rides to shopping, crafts to cuisine, you can find it during a weekend in this southern Vermont town.
